reviewRule: The existing10% scenario/origin degradation tolerance is applied to every fixed existing native baseline, including seasonal naive and OLS that were scored but excluded from the prior adoption gate. A verified material failure against a same-available-history baseline suffices to reject the exact candidate. All comparators and cells remain visible; no per-cell winning model is selected. This is an expanded retrospective review, not the original preregistered adoption result or a new confirmatory holdout.
decisionBoundary: This audit can only verify final rejection. If no supported failure exists, stop without adoption; broader untouched testing would then be required. No new seed histories, model fits, parameter search, added fields or alternative candidates are generated here.
unperformedReason: An existing exact-candidate failure already prevents adoption; do not run unnecessary tests to search for a favorable result or re-scope the candidate after rejection.
